mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, we are looking at overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park with a full moon. The ISS passes tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. The overnight low will be 54 degrees with no rain expected.

The Plan Commission has an agenda for November 4th covering multiple developments like the Ardent Glen addition and site plans for Milky Way. Additionally, property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th, with payment options available through the city treasurer.

There is plenty to do in our area, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today. You can also catch live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company today, with trivia nights and yoga classes scheduled throughout the following week.
In a report from Thursday, October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving, though no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor of the day is the always delicious Turtle. The store is currently open and serving until 10:30 PM tonight.
